GOOD QUESTIONS.

A little
clarity.

What can I try right now?+

Morning and evening reflections, custom habits, water logging, and sample pattern and recipe screens. This is mock version 1: no account and no permanent storage. Reloading or leaving the app clears your entries.

Can I use it on my phone?+

Yes, this web preview works on phones, tablets, and computers. Dedicated iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. A release date has not been announced.

Does it connect to my health data or journal?+

Not yet. Sleep, steps, workout connections, journal scanning, and real personal insights are planned for the full product. This preview does not access those sources.

Is Intend a medical service?+

No. Intend is for personal reflection, not diagnosis, treatment, or medical advice. Future insights will show associations, not causes.

Do I need to sign up?+

No sign-up is needed. Please use sample information while exploring. Accounts and saved history will be introduced separately.
